limitations: The generic proper-metric statement uses strong zero-dimensionality. The magnitude fingerprint is injective but no quantitative stability is proved, and singleton subsets are not distinguished. The main conclusions are structural consequences of very recent algebraic-independence and finite-magnitude theorems, so originality is to the best of our knowledge with residual risk from later revisions or unindexed parallel observations.
record_title: Generic proper algebraically independent metrics have ambiently unique magnitude fingerprints
